strings.off_no_crucible: Threshold is off: this server does not run Meadworks.
strings.off_no_threshold: Threshold is off: this server does not run Threshold.
strings.portal_edit_no_reply: The server did not confirm the change. Try again.
strings.step_aside: Threshold is off: {0} routes portals. Remove it to use Threshold; Meadworks can import its settings.
strings.te_step_aside: TeleportEverything is installed: Threshold leaves listed items and tames to it.
strings.import_done: Imported {0} settings from {1}. The original files are unchanged.
strings.hover_walk_in: Walk in to choose a destination
strings.picker_unnamed: Name this portal before choosing a destination.
strings.hover_target: Walk into this named portal to choose a destination.
strings.picker_carry_warning: You carry items that portals refuse.
strings.carry_blocked: You carry items that cannot pass through this portal.
strings.cart_blocked: Your cart carries items that cannot pass through this portal.
strings.cart_stays: Your cart stays here: someone else is using it.
strings.refusal_not_creator_or_admin: Only the portal's builder or an admin can change its hub.
strings.refusal_not_admin: Only an admin can change hubs.
strings.refusal_name_taken: Another hub already has that name.
strings.refusal_tagged_portal: A hub must be a portal without a tag.
strings.refusal_no_access: You may not use that portal.
strings.refusal_same_portal: You are already at that portal.
strings.refusal_unknown_portal: The server does not know that portal yet.
strings.refusal_unknown_player: The server does not know your character yet.
strings.refusal_modes_off: Access modes are off on this server.
strings.refusal_not_owner: Only the portal's owner can change its access.
strings.refusal_tag_locked: Only the portal's owner or an admin can change this portal's tag.
strings.import_note_language_not_imported: Language follows the game; PortalSelector's language setting is not imported.
strings.import_note_font_not_imported: Fonts come from the Meadworks look; PortalSelector's font setting is not imported.
strings.import_note_hub_not_found: PortalSelector's main portal was not found; set the hub again with one click.
strings.import_note_cheat_applies_where_allowed: Ignore Teleport Restrictions was imported as on; it acts in single player, on the host or where the server allows it.
strings.import_note_invalid_value: A value outside its choices was skipped.
strings.sg_pillar_desc: Build two on the shore or in shallow water, 10 to 15 m apart with water between them: a portal for ships opens between them.
strings.sg_unpaired: Not paired: build a second pillar 10 to 15 m away across the water
strings.sg_hover_sailin: Sail in with someone at the helm to pick any sea gate
strings.sg_pair_far: Too far from the other pillar: {0} m, at most {1} m
strings.sg_pair_close: Too close to the other pillar: {0} m, at least {1} m
strings.sg_pair_height: {0} m higher or lower than the other pillar, at most {1} m
strings.sg_pair_shallow: Too shallow between or beside the pillars: {0} m deep, a ship needs {1} m
strings.sg_pair_deep: Too deep for a pillar: {0} m under water, at most {1} m
strings.sg_fix_hint: Fix it and the gate opens by itself
strings.sg_denied_gone: The destination sea gate is gone
strings.sg_denied_cargo: Ore and other restricted cargo cannot pass through a sea gate
strings.sg_denied_notready: The sea gate was not ready: sail through again
strings.sg_denied_nohelm: A ship passes through a sea gate only with someone at the helm
strings.sg_fallback: The ship did not arrive in time: you were set ashore by the gate
strings.sg_denied_private: Only the destination gate's owner may sail there
strings.sg_denied_admin: Only a server admin may sail to the destination gate
strings.sg_notowner: You do not own this sea gate
strings.sg_picker_empty: No other sea gate you may sail to
strings.sg_crew_wait: {0} at the helm picks the sea gate
strings.picker_search_help: Filter the currently permitted portal list by its visible destination names. Searching does not travel or change portal settings.
strings.picker_destination_help: Travel to this portal. Existing access, discovery, carrying and fuel checks still apply. Right-click toggles its favorite status instead.
strings.picker_category_help: This is a destination-category heading, not a travel target.
strings.picker_favorite_help: Add or remove the selected destination from your character's favorites. This does not travel or rename the portal.
strings.picker_home_help: Set the selected hub as your home hub, or clear it when it is already your home. This does not travel.
strings.picker_source_hub_help: Request that the current source portal become a named hub, or clear its hub status. Existing creator, ward and admin checks still apply.
strings.picker_return_help: Travel to the available return hub. Existing travel permissions, carrying and fuel checks still apply.
strings.picker_close_help: Close the destination picker and return to the minimap.
strings.picker_map_pins_hint: Double-click the map to place a pin. Right-click a pin to remove it.
strings.cfg_1_general__enabled_help: Whole product. Off: portals pair by tag as in the game.
strings.cfg_1_general__teleport_mode_help: Map: integrated map and list. TargetTeleport: named destinations in a dropdown, then Teleport. Default: portals pair by matching tag, as in the game; portal access modes and icons are off. Quick jumps and sea gates work in every mode.
strings.cfg_1_general__ore_transport_help: Routed trips: Blocked keeps ordinary item restrictions; StoneToStone allows restricted items only between portals that allow all items; FromStoneToWood preserves the game's source-portal rule; All allows restricted items from every portal. Hard item blocks and world restrictions remain.
strings.cfg_1_general__portal_prefabs_help: Comma list of portal prefab names in the list. Empty: every prefab with a portal component, modded ones included.
strings.cfg_1_general__list_untagged_portals_hel: Untagged portals are destinations too, as in Wayfare. Off: only tagged portals and hubs.
strings.cfg_1_general__only_explored_portals_hel: Portals in map areas the player has not explored are hidden from the list and the map.
strings.cfg_1_general__locked_player_settings_he: Comma list of player settings (Section.Key) the server forces on every player.
strings.cfg_2_hubs__return_to_hub_help: The Return To Hub button on the travel map (every portal opens the map when walked into). Always: at every portal that is not a hub, to your home hub (set from a hub on the map; no button until one is usable). UnpairedOnly: only at portals without a tag pair. Off: no button.
strings.cfg_2_hubs__hub_editing_help: Who may make a portal a hub or clear it.
strings.cfg_2_hubs__max_hubs_help: Named hubs per world. Each tagged portal returns to its nearest hub.
strings.cfg_3_access__access_modes_enabled_help: Owners may make their portals Private; admins may also make them Admin. Off: every portal is Public.
strings.cfg_3_access__default_access_mode_help: Access mode of a newly built portal.
strings.cfg_4_picker__sort_help: How portals are ordered inside each group of the picker: Name sorts them alphabetically, Distance puts the nearest first.
strings.cfg_4_picker__tag_edit_key_help: On a hub: open the game's tag input instead of the picker.
strings.cfg_4_picker__mode_cycle_key_help: On your own portal: cycle its access mode (Shift + E is the tag edit key).
strings.cfg_4_picker__highlight_stone_portals_he: Portals that let every item through (the game's stone portal) get their own Stone Portals group in the list and gray pins on the maps, so destinations for ore are easy to find. Off: they sort into their access group with the usual colors.
strings.cfg_5_map__use_game_map_help: Show the game's own map image in the picker. Off: a plain fallback map.
strings.cfg_5_map__hide_unexplored_map_help: Fallback map only: cover unexplored areas with fog.
strings.cfg_5_map__show_map_labels_help: Show portal tags beside their pins.
strings.cfg_5_map__start_zoom_help: Picker map zoom when it opens.
strings.cfg_5_map__show_portal_pins_help: Show the portals you may use as pins on the ordinary map, apart from your own pins.
strings.cfg_5_map__spread_clustered_pins_help: Spread pins of portals standing close together so they do not overlap.
strings.cfg_5_map__portal_pins_key_help: On the open large map: show or hide the portal pins (turns Show Portal Pins on or off). Unbound by default; Show Portal Pins is also a setting.
strings.cfg_6_fuel__fuel_enabled_help: Each trip Threshold routes consumes Fuel Amount of Fuel Item from the traveler's inventory. Ignore Teleport Restrictions waives it.
strings.cfg_6_fuel__fuel_item_help: Item prefab name consumed per trip.
strings.cfg_7_jumps__quick_portals_help: Near portals jump quicker than the game's 8 s, down to Quick Portal Seconds.
strings.cfg_7_jumps__quick_portal_range_help: Map meters between two portals at which a jump takes the game's full 8 s.
strings.cfg_7_jumps__quick_portal_seconds_help: Seconds a jump takes between portals side by side.
strings.cfg_7_jumps__screen_only_when_loading_he: A jump into an area already loaded keeps the screen clear.
strings.cfg_7_jumps__quick_area_loading_help: After a long jump the land around you loads as fast as your PC allows.
strings.cfg_7_jumps__arrival_protection_seconds_: After a portal trip you take no damage and creatures do not target you for this long. 0: off.
strings.cfg_7_jumps__bring_tames_help: Tames following you (follow command) within Tame Radius come through the portal with you. Off: they stay, as in the game.
strings.cfg_7_jumps__tame_radius_help: Meters around you in which following tames come along.
strings.cfg_7_jumps__max_tames_help: Most tames that come along per trip, nearest first.
strings.cfg_7_jumps__bring_carts_help: The cart you are pulling comes through the portal with you, its load intact, and stands in front of you on arrival. A cart carrying ores or other restricted items follows Ore Transport: by default it passes only from a stone portal. Off: the cart stays, as in the game.
strings.cfg_8_sea_gates__enabled_help: Sea gates: two pillars open a portal for ships. Experimental, off by default.
strings.cfg_8_sea_gates__pillar_recipe_help: What one pillar costs, as Item:Amount pairs.
strings.cfg_8_sea_gates__min_gate_width_help: Closest two pillars may stand to pair, in meters.
strings.cfg_8_sea_gates__max_gate_width_help: Farthest two pillars may stand to pair, in meters.
strings.cfg_8_sea_gates__min_water_depth_help: Water depth a gate needs, in meters.
strings.cfg_8_sea_gates__protection_seconds_help: After a jump, the ship and its crew take no damage for this long.
strings.cfg_8_sea_gates__crew_wait_seconds_help: How long the crew waits for the ship before being set ashore.
strings.cfg_9_cheats__ignore_teleport_restrictio: Carry anything through portals and sea gates, ores and metals included, and travel without fuel. Off by default; the server decides in multiplayer.
strings.cfg_9_cheats__teleport_listed_items_help: Carry the items named in Listed Items through portals Threshold routes, even where the game forbids them. Fuel still applies. Off by default; the server decides in multiplayer.
strings.cfg_9_cheats__listed_items_help: Comma list of item prefab names Teleport Listed Items lets through (default: ores and metals).
